title: Macro Precision, Recall and F1
signature: def precision_recall_f1(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, num_classes: int) -> tuple
hints: Per class c: TP = predicted c and truly c, FP = predicted c but not c, FN = truly c but not predicted c.
Precision = TP / (TP + FP) and recall = TP / (TP + FN). Use 0 whenever a denominator is 0, and compute F1 per class too.
Macro F1 is the mean of the per-class F1 scores. It is not the harmonic mean of macro precision and macro recall.
